info.name: VirusTotal API v3 - Private Scanning Private Scanning…
info.description:
Submit files and URLs for analysis without sharing the artefact with the VirusTotal community. Mirrors the public scanning surface (Files / URLs / Analyses / Behaviours / Zip Files).
